GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when librarians request live aggregate data on circulation activities such as loan counts, reservation counts, or fine totals.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about circulation statistics such as loan counts, reservation counts, or fines, use LibraryAgentAnalyticsAction.
Do not provide member-specific details or perform write operations.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide live aggregate circulation information, including data on loans, reservations, and fines. You cannot modify data or provide member-specific details.
